law_name: Personal Data Protection Code (Legislative Decree 196/2003, Codice privacy)
deceased_data: GDPR rights (arts. 15-22) exercisable by persons with own interest, agent or family reasons unless deceased forbade in writing (art. 2-terdecies)
research_exemption: Medical/biomedical/epidemiological research without consent with ethics committee opinion and Garante safeguards (art. 110, amended 2024; Garante provv. 298/2024)
genetic_data: Processing only with Garante safeguard measures, renewed at least every two years (art. 2-septies; provv. 146/2019 annex 4)
notes: D.lgs. 196/2003 as amended by D.lgs. 101/2018 (GDPR adaptation, in force 2018-09-19)
